title: When Can I Wear Jeans After a BBL?
meta_description: No source sets a date for jeans after a BBL. Avoid direct pressure for at least 8 weeks and wait 3 months to shop for clothes, The Aesthetic Society says.
excerpt: No source sets a date for jeans after a BBL. Here is the closest guidance, from The Aesthetic Society, what to wear until your surgeon clears you, and how to choose jeans when you get there.
quick_answer:
When can I wear jeans after a BBL?

No source sets a date. The Aesthetic Society says to avoid direct pressure on the buttocks for at least 8 weeks and not to shop for clothes for at least 3 months, because swelling hides your final results. Ask your surgeon at follow-up, and wear loose clothes over your garment until then.
